From: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>

Subject: Post-call: Proposal for a rotating deep-dive / demo cadence (next steps)

Hi Ethan / Priya —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap from our side:
- Needs: low-latency inference for multi-tenant clinical summarization, strong logging/audit for SOC2, and predictable cost targets for monthly volume growth.
- Stakeholders: Ethan (product), Priya (eng), Satoshi will evaluate infra impacts for APAC.

Next steps you asked for: schedule a technical deep-dive + demo with your infra and security leads, and align a repeating cadence that works for US/EU/APAC. To avoid repeated calendar ping-pong, I’m proposing a small rotating slot plan so each region gets at least one convenient meeting window every 2 weeks.

Suggested rotation (we can tweak times):
- Week A: US morning (PDT) — 10:00 PDT / 13:00 EDT / 17:00 BST / 18:00 CEST / 01:00 JST next day
- Week B: EU afternoon (BST/CEST) — 15:00 BST / 16:00 CEST / 10:00 EDT / 07:00 PDT / 23:00 JST
- Week C: APAC morning (JST) — 09:00 JST / 01:00 CEST / 00:00 BST / 17:00 EDT previous day / 14:00 PDT previous day

Concrete first options for the deep-dive (90 minutes):
- Option 1: Tue, May 27 — 10:00 PDT / 18:00 CEST (good for US + EU overlap)
- Option 2: Wed, May 28 — 15:00 BST / 23:00 JST (better for EU + APAC)
- Option 3: Thu, May 29 — 09:00 JST / 17:00 EDT (APAC-first window)

If you confirm one of the above options I’ll send a calendar invite with an agenda and attach the mutual action plan + networking requirements we referenced (see attached). For the rotating cadence, we can start with a 3-week rotation and reevaluate after the first month.

Ask: please reply with a preferred option + any additional participants (SLA/contact ops/security) you want on the invite.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this on calendar.

—
Maya Srinivasan
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
(attachment: mutual_action_plan.xlsx) (attachment: networking_requirements.pdf)

Maya — thanks for the clear recap. All three options look reasonable on the surface. Quick notes from our side:
- Priya wants our infra leads on the call (Satoshi and I will bring him in).
- We prefer Option 2 or Option 3 — Option 1 is okay but late for EU folks.

Availability specifics (our regional constraints):
- US (Ethan): prefers 17:00–19:00 EDT on Tue/Wed
- EU (Priya): prefers 14:00–16:30 BST/CEST on Tue/Thu
- APAC (Satoshi): prefers 09:00–11:00 JST on Wed/Thu (earlier slots are hard due to on-call)

If it helps, here’s an explicit candidate that overlaps EU+APAC without pushing EU too late: Wed, May 28 at 15:00 BST (16:00 CEST) — that works for Priya and should be acceptable for Satoshi at 23:00 JST if we keep the demo to 75 mins. Otherwise Thu May 29 09:00 JST / 17:00 EDT also looks doable.

I’ll let Satoshi confirm the APAC on-call constraint; tagging him below.

—
Ethan
Product Lead, ZenWell

Thanks for proposing the options. If you can add these to the agenda and the shared drive, we’ll prep ahead of the meeting.
